about: Embark on a legendary journey with the Rabbids in this hilarious party game! Join them on an incredible quest, filled with hilarious moments!
Gather with friends and family and enjoy a multitude of ridiculously fun mini-games in the most epic Rabbids party yet.
- Jump into multiplayer mayhem with up to four players locally.
- Team up and face off across 50 fun mini-games.
- Build a custom playlist of your favorite mini-games.
- Anyone can get in on the action with customizable difficulty levels and intuitive controls.
summary: Embark on a legendary journey with the Rabbids in this hilarious party game!
